A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (type line and corrected game text), meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 March 2017.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-mediumrepeatingblastercannon-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Medium Repeating Blaster Cannon (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the 2013 slip. As a slip it has the black strip with a white italic “E”, but no title in the strip. Unlike the 2013 slip, it also shows the two number boxes at the left of the text box (3 and 1).

The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
